original_description:
Falcon Herbs Naagkesar (Mesua ferrea) – 100g Pure Powder

Authentically sourced from the fragrant flowers of the Mesua ferrea tree, our Naagkesar powder is traditionally valued in Ayurvedic practices for its distinctive aroma and natural qualities. Hand-harvested and sun-dried to preserve its subtle floral essence, this fine powder is ideal for those who appreciate the timeless wisdom of herbal traditions.

Naagkesar has long been used in classical formulations for its cooling nature and aromatic profile. Its delicate fragrance is often appreciated in personal care rituals and herbal blends, offering a soothing sensory experience. In traditional preparations, it is sometimes blended with other herbs to support holistic well-being as part of daily routines.

Traditional Uses & Qualities

  • Gently aromatic, used in herbal mixtures for its pleasant, floral scent
  • Traditionally incorporated in formulations to support natural balance during seasonal transitions
  • Valued for its cooling properties in Ayurvedic texts
  • Used in heritage recipes for oral and personal care preparations
  • Ideal for blending with other herbs in DIY Ayurvedic formulations

Our Naagkesar is 100% pure, chemical-free, and ethically wild-harvested. Packaged in a resealable, eco-friendly pouch to retain freshness and fragrance. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

For external or internal use as per traditional guidance. Consult a qualified Ayurvedic practitioner before use, especially if pregnant, nursing, or on long-term herbal regimens.

Experience the timeless essence of Naagkesar — a gift from nature, rooted in tradition.

---
